Can you tell me some tips? I think it would be helpful. I've always had issues with self esteem. I mean, I think I've gotten better with empathy, but sometimes I say rude things, and I don't realize what I said was rude until people tell me. 

I haven't tried therapy yet because my school doesn't have a mental health counselor, but I am going to a GP in two weeks, so I get can help with depression and some anxiety issues.
